semantics.normalizer: Actual NativePolicy.normalized_robot, including zero invalid past history and raw history-valid bit.
semantics.robot: Canonical pre-action observed q/qd, actual current actuator target and strictly previous actual issued/applied target; ages and elapsed on actual native timestamps.
semantics.phases: First contact is a completed transition with any fingertip/object force >0.1N in either physics sample. Observation at that transition still precedes contact; following observation begins first24. Unmeasured other hand-body contacts can precede detection.
semantics.source_identity: Cached source SHA256 is reported; large original HDF5 images are not rehashed. Numeric fields are reread from all77 HDF5 records; autonomous numeric files are hashed.
semantics.interpretation: Large z values show scale/distribution excursions, not clipping or causal normalization failure. No policy input, statistics, weights or train sampling changed.
